title: Forecast Combination: Anti-QLIKE Weighted Ensemble of HAR-ABS + HAR-VIX

HAR-ABS.note: static, fit on IS 2005-2018 only (consistent with K530)

HAR-VIX.note: static, fit on IS 2005-2018 only (consistent with K530)

conclusions: QLIKE ranking: Bates-Granger=-3.9181, HAR-VIX=-3.9170, Anti-QLIKE=-3.9167, Equal-Weight=-3.9138, HAR-ABS=-3.8918

No combination significantly outperforms HAR-VIX at Harvey 3σ threshold. VIX is a sufficient statistic for SPY daily |r| forecasting over 2019-2024. Best combo Bates-Granger: QLIKE=-3.9181 vs HAR-VIX=-3.9170.
Final Anti-QLIKE weights: HAR-ABS=0.000, HAR-VIX=1.000. HAR-VIX dominates the combination.

lookahead_prevention.combination_weights: expanding window over OOS[0..t-2] QLIKE losses only

notes: HAR coefficients static (IS 2005-2018), consistent with K530 approach
Bates-Granger constrained OLS: β1+β2=1, β1∈[0,1], expanding window
Anti-QLIKE weighting: w_i ∝ 1/(excess_i + EPS) where excess_i = mean_QLIKE_i - min(mean_QLIKE_abs, mean_QLIKE_vix); always positive even when raw QLIKE is negative
Forecast floor: max(yhat, 1e-6) to prevent log(0) in QLIKE
DM-HLN Harvey threshold: |t| > 3.0 (Harvey et al. 1997); h=1 (1-step-ahead), NW bandwidth=T^(1/3) kept separate from h
VIX forward-fill for missing market holidays; >5 consecutive triggers warning
